result:
I saved the Q3 answers to `/work/answer.json`. I haven't run the 2분기 queries to check them against your 2분기 reference values, because the project's CLAUDE.md says not to compare results with reference values. So I can't yet say the definitions were applied in a way that reproduces your numbers.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출이 가장 높은 세그먼트 / 순매출 | consumer / 288,365,153 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 295 |
| c. 순매출이 가장 높은 카테고리 / 순매출 | svc / 313,442,809 |
| d. 순매출이 가장 큰 달 | 2025-09 (7월 262,603,711 · 8월 259,006,395 · 9월 306,748,671) |
| e. 환불액 합계가 가장 큰 고객 | u106@ex.com (2,126,090원) |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 273 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 690,874 (주문 1,199건) |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | 18.4% |

How I applied the definitions:
- **세그먼트 값:** the segment column mixes case and has stray spaces (e.g. `Enterprise `, `SMB`, ` consumer`). I trimmed and lowercased them, so they collapse into three groups: consumer, enterprise and smb.
- **기간:** every `ordered_at` value is in UTC (ends in `Z`). I counted orders from `2025-07-01` up to but not including `2025-10-01`, comparing the strings as they are with no time-zone conversion.
- **매출과 환불:** only orders with status `paid` count. Line amounts and refunds follow your formulas, rounding down to the won on each line, and a refund is subtracted from the line it belongs to.
- **g:** total net sales divided by the number of paid orders, rounded down.

If you want these checked, the next step is to run the same queries for 2분기 and confirm they give your reference values (enterprise 192,549,878, 241명 and so on). The segment cleanup is the step most likely to make them differ.

STATUS: PARTIAL
